title: Micro-journey snippet cards and compact empty-state frames for first-run console tour
creator: Anika Patel
description: Design a set of compact, reusable 'micro-journey' snippet cards plus modular empty-state frames and screenshot scaffolds for the console first-run tour. These assets must cover desktop and narrow-width (700px) flows, include accessible color/token variants, and provide localized copy placeholders. The goal is a lightweight visual system that product engineers can drop into the console tour renderer and marketing screenshots without heavy rework.
acceptance_criteria: A library of 12 micro-journey cards (illustration + 1-line action + supportive subtext) exported as Figma components and 1x/2x PNGs for 3 themes: Default, HighContrast, and Subtle
3 modular empty-state frames (Checklist, No-Data Table, Action-Focused CTA) with tokenized spacing and subcomponent naming that maps to console CSS classes

Screenshot scaffolding: 4 prebuilt screenshot compositions (desktop, 1200x640; tablet, 1024x560; narrow, 700x420; compact, 480x320) with layer naming conventions and sample prompts for marketing and release notes
Accessibility: contrast ratios annotated on each frame and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance notes in the Figma file
Localization placeholders for English, Spanish, German, and Japanese with truncated copy examples to test wrapping
Developer handoff doc (Confluence link) describing usage tokens, export sizes, and recommended class hooks for the tour renderer
review_feedback: PM Claire Hsu: prefer concise action verbs in primary line; suggested swapping 'Start' -> 'Connect' for initial provider step.
Eng lead Jamal Ortiz: component padding should map to token 'space-sm/space-md' to simplify renderer mapping; also requested export slices named with 'tour-card--v2' suffix.
Accessibility review (Lara Kim): HighContrast theme passes color contrast; checklist frame needs focus outline states added for keyboard nav.
Localization (I18n) note from Sara Müller: German copy will frequently be longer — reserve 20% width for wrapping tests in narrow layout.
decisions: Adopt tokenized spacing (space-sm/space-md/space-lg) across all frames to reduce CSS mapping friction.
Use single-line primary microcopy + optional two-line supportive text pattern for all cards to maintain vertical rhythm.
Export pattern: provide SVG for illustration + 1x/2x PNGs for full compositions; developers to compose in DOM when possible.
Create a small CSS utility class set (.tour-card, .tour-empty, .tour-cta) documented in handoff doc for immediate integration.
